bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to human services; authorizing a supplemental rate for a housing support provider in Washington County; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256I.05, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256I.05, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 1y.+]

[+Supplemental rate; Washington County.+]

[+(a) Notwithstanding the provisions of subdivisions 1a and 1c, upon the effective date of this subdivision, a county agency must negotiate a supplemental rate for up to 29 beds in addition to the rate specified in subdivision 1, not to exceed $1,028 per month, including any legislatively authorized inflationary adjustments, for housing support providers located in Washington County that operate facilities providing room and board and supplementary services to adults who: +]

[+(1)(i) have a primary diagnosis of mental illness, substance use disorder, or co-occurring mental illness and substance use disorder; or +]

[+(ii) are experiencing housing instability; and +]

[+(2) demonstrate related functional or behavioral health support needs. +]

[+(b) The provider must deliver 24-hour-a-day supervision and other support services. The supplemental rate negotiated under this subdivision must be effective retroactively from April 1, 2026. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to human services; authorizing a supplemental rate for a housing support provider in Washington County; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256I.05, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 256I.05, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 1y.

Supplemental rate; Washington County.

(a) Notwithstanding the provisions of subdivisions 1a and 1c, upon the effective date of this subdivision, a county agency must negotiate a supplemental rate for up to 29 beds in addition to the rate specified in subdivision 1, not to exceed $1,028 per month, including any legislatively authorized inflationary adjustments, for housing support providers located in Washington County that operate facilities providing room and board and supplementary services to adults who:

(1)(i) have a primary diagnosis of mental illness, substance use disorder, or co-occurring mental illness and substance use disorder; or

(ii) are experiencing housing instability; and

(2) demonstrate related functional or behavioral health support needs.

(b) The provider must deliver 24-hour-a-day supervision and other support services. The supplemental rate negotiated under this subdivision must be effective retroactively from April 1, 2026.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (a) Notwithstanding the provisions of subdivisions 1a and 1c, upon the effective date of this subdivision, a county agency must negotiate a supplemental rate for up to 29 beds in addition to the rate specified in subdivision 1, not to exceed $1,028 per month, including any legislatively authorized inflationary adjustments, for housing support providers located in Washington County that operate facilities providing room and board and supplementary services to adults who:
(1)(i) have a primary diagnosis of mental illness, substance use disorder, or co-occurring mental illness and substance use disorder; or
(2) demonstrate related functional or behavioral health support needs.
(b) The provider must deliver 24-hour-a-day supervision and other support services. The supplemental rate negotiated under this subdivision must be effective retroactively from April 1, 2026.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
